title: Computer Network Support Specialists
description: Analyze, test, troubleshoot, and evaluate existing network systems, such as local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), cloud networks, servers, and other data communications networks. Perform network maintenance to ensure networks operate correctly with minimal interruption.

tasks.text: Back up network data.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Backup configuration largely automatable with oversight

dwas.name: Create electronic data backup to prevent loss of information.

tasks.text: Configure security settings or access permissions for groups or individuals.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Security implementation needs human judgment and deployment

dwas.name: Implement security measures for computer or information systems.

tasks.text: Analyze and report computer network security breaches or attempted breaches.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Security analysis aided; human validates findings

dwas.name: Analyze security of systems, network, or data.

tasks.text: Identify the causes of networking problems, using diagnostic testing software and equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Network troubleshooting needs hands-on diagnosis

tasks.text: Document network support activities.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft network activity documentation from inputs

tasks.text: Configure wide area network (WAN) or local area network (LAN) routers or related equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Network config needs physical setup and verification

tasks.text: Install network software, including security or firewall software.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Software install often needs hands-on machine access

tasks.text: Troubleshoot network or connectivity problems for users or user groups.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI assists diagnosis; human executes fixes

dwas.name: Troubleshoot issues with computer applications or systems.

tasks.text: Provide telephone support related to networking or connectivity issues.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnoses need live system access and hands-on fixes

dwas.name: Provide technical support for computer network issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Evaluate local area network (LAN) or wide area network (WAN) performance data to ensure sufficient availability or speed, to identify network problems, or for disaster recovery purposes.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI interprets test output; human executes tests

dwas.name: Test computer system operations to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Analyze network data to determine network usage, disk space availability, or server function.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI monitors network performance via telemetry

dwas.name: Monitor the performance of computer networks.
Analyze data to identify or resolve operational problems.

tasks.text: Perform routine maintenance or standard repairs to networking components or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical hardware maintenance and part replacement

tasks.text: Configure and define parameters for installation or testing of local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN), hubs, routers, switches, controllers, multiplexers, or related networking equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Network specs drafted; human validates

dwas.name: Develop specifications for computer network operation.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.rationale: decision support — Network troubleshooting needs hands-on diagnosis

tasks.text: Monitor industry Web sites or publications for information about patches, releases, viruses, or potential problem identification.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI scans trend sources; human weighs relevance

dwas.name: Update knowledge about emerging industry or technology trends.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft network activity documentation from inputs

tasks.text: Train users in procedures related to network applications software or related systems.
